question: Which market-data source class, if any, may be admitted for research, backtesting and eventual production?
owner_decision: Project policy choice — not made by this review.
known_evidence: A third-party historical game log with line fields exists in the repository; a first-party operator page also exposes current market categories. Neither source has been admitted here, and the historical file does not provide a separate timestamped open/close pair.
missing_evidence: License/terms approval, quote-time and line conventions, jurisdiction mapping, event-key joins, opening/closing history, and the boundary between research-only and production use.
cheapest_route: Review the source/terms matrix and approve one of official-only, licensed-feed, or separately labeled third-party research-lane policies before any market residual or backtest is published.
why_it_matters: This is a source-policy blocker, not a claim that the repository contains no price-like data.

question: What is the canonical Week 10 injury-read pair, and which published elapsed-time statement should be corrected?
owner_decision: No duration chosen until the original read artifacts are reconciled.
known_evidence: Saved timestamps differ by 25 hours 13 minutes; the prior register/page say 49 hours, while executive and coordination prose say 1 hour 13 minutes.
missing_evidence: A matching pair of immutable source captures or proof that one stored timestamp is a transcription error.
cheapest_route: Compare the exact two saved captures/manifest entries, verify source URLs and local clocks, then derive the duration in code and replace all dependent prose in the owning desk after approval.
why_it_matters: Capture cadence and injury-surprise claims depend on the correct elapsed interval.

question: How should Week 11 availability be represented when the NFL league endpoint serves Week 10 but some clubs publish Week 11 practice reports?
owner_decision: Coverage policy needed; this review does not select a fallback or mark missing clubs healthy.
known_evidence: The requested NFL.com /reg11 URL returned /reg10; the Texans' official Week 11 article covers Houston and Indianapolis with practice-status columns only.
missing_evidence: A complete, dated 32-club capture and final game-status/inactive evidence for the relevant slate.
cheapest_route: Define explicit per-club states (published, not yet published, bye/not applicable, unavailable source), then source and capture each club separately until the coverage gate clears.
why_it_matters: Treating a stale league endpoint or missing row as an all-clear can produce false availability inputs.

question: What transaction evidence is required before repeating the claim that both Baltimore quarterbacks were placed on IR?
owner_decision: The claim stays unresolved; no absence-based conclusion is selected here.
known_evidence: The inherited reserve capture is partial and lacks a position field; its only stored Baltimore row is dated Oct. 24. A partial trades capture lists Jacoby Brissett from Arizona to Baltimore on Nov. 6, also without a position field.
missing_evidence: Complete paginated official reserve history for the relevant date window and a separate official source for any position claim.
cheapest_route: Re-read all reserve-list pages/per-club results for the full date interval; retain page boundaries and source row references; do not infer position from a transaction row or news headline.
answer_status: OPEN — prior correction is stronger than the captured evidence
why_it_matters: IR status is a roster event, not interchangeable with an injury report, a news timeline, or an absent row on a capped page.

question: May any player-level Game Book material be retained, modeled or publicly displayed?
owner_decision: Rights decision required; this review used no player-level Game Book rows.
known_evidence: The official PDF's own notice restricts use to assisting media coverage and requires written permission for other use.
missing_evidence: Written permission/license covering this project's planned storage, extraction, model use and publication, or a different expressly authorized feed.
cheapest_route: Ask the rights holder for written scope-specific permission; if it is unavailable, keep Game Book rows out of the pipeline and select an authorized alternative.
why_it_matters: A publicly reachable official PDF is not an unrestricted data license.

question: When may the Week 10 result update be considered integrated into the verified 2026 record?
owner_decision: The one-game delta is recorded; full-feed integration has not been declared.
known_evidence: NFL.com Game Center and schedule show Chargers 23, Ravens 20, Final; a one-row delta is source-linked in this dossier.
missing_evidence: A rebuilt full result feed at a declared cutoff and a post-update 32-club standings reconciliation.
cheapest_route: Apply the single final row, rebuild from the chosen source set, assert each game appears once, and compare each club record—not only league totals—to the same-cut official standings.
answer_status: PARTIAL — source delta verified, integration not verified
why_it_matters: A final result can change training data, standings and model cutoffs; the one-row delta is not a full reconciliation.

question: What source, quote-time and jurisdiction evidence is required before calling a current operator quote an admitted market price?
owner_decision: Policy and source approval remain open; no quote values were copied into this dossier.
known_evidence: DraftKings returned NFL spread/total/moneyline categories; a server-time label had no stated timezone, and an embedded image URL had a US-RI token.
missing_evidence: Terms/redistribution rights, quote-level line and timestamp, event identity, jurisdiction, and validated opening/closing capture.
cheapest_route: Obtain an authorized archive/feed or a terms-cleared capture method that records jurisdiction, market, line, event ID, local/UTC time and raw response hash.
why_it_matters: A current market page and an opaque location token do not establish a historical, local, executable price or CLV baseline.

question: Which home-field coefficient is canonical, and should REQ-04 remain marked MET while its market residual is undefined?
owner_decision: The model and requirement status need reconciliation in their owning desk; this review changes neither.
known_evidence: Model card and forecast rows use -0.52; Q-05 and executive prose use -0.46. REQ-04 is MET while its own gate says the difference is undefined and market values are blank.
missing_evidence: A reproducible canonical coefficient from frozen code/data and a populated approved market line/derived residual or a revised requirement status.
cheapest_route: Re-run the model from its frozen inputs, reconcile all prose to the emitted coefficient, and mark market-difference readiness blocked until an approved price is present.
why_it_matters: Conflicting model metadata and a MET status over an undefined quantity undermine decision readiness.

question: What evidence gates are mandatory before a strategy can appear as validated skill or earn a reward?
owner_decision: No promotion threshold or policy is changed by this review.
known_evidence: The reviewed P-01/P-02/P-03 entries each have 13 forecasts and zero settled rows; proper-score and benchmark fields are blank. Strategy registrations and a shadow model card exist.
missing_evidence: A sufficiently large chronological holdout, source-cleared inputs, uncertainty/calibration bounds, benchmark comparisons and demotion results.
cheapest_route: Keep all strategies in shadow; freeze registration hashes; define sample/benchmark/uncertainty gates before settlement; show proper scores separately from staking.
why_it_matters: No result from a zero-settled sample supports a performance claim; raw win rate/ROI is especially noisy.

question: What evidence is required before any parlay or same-game combo is admitted?
owner_decision: Combo policy remains blocked unless joint evidence and the applicable operator rules are both selected and validated.
known_evidence: FanDuel describes its own void-leg handling; the inherited strategy ledger withholds game parlays and same-game parlays for lack of validated joint evidence.
missing_evidence: A calibrated joint-probability model and the exact applicable operator/jurisdiction settlement rules.
cheapest_route: Keep combos withheld; validate joint outcomes on chronological holdouts and separately capture the operator's rules before reconsideration.
why_it_matters: Operator settlement does not validate independence or a product of marginal probabilities.

question: What source-retention format is permitted for future independent audits?
owner_decision: Retention and redistribution policy is not selected here.
known_evidence: This dossier stores a short response-note and local table hashes, not complete source responses; hashes do not authenticate source-server bytes.
missing_evidence: A permission-compatible raw capture, exact request/final URL, status/headers, precise local capture time and a documented retention policy.
cheapest_route: Define a source-capture template and rights checklist before the next automated read; otherwise keep an explicit summary-only label and do not call it an archive.
why_it_matters: Independent reviewers need to distinguish source-server evidence from a later local transcription.

question: Which historical results feed is canonical, and how are historical team aliases normalized before club-level joins?
owner_decision: The canonical source and alias-map ownership remain for the integration/data owner; this review does not rewrite either feed.
known_evidence: The older e46fb855 feed contains 9 LAR and 9 ARI appearances while the prior official standings transcription uses LA and AZ; the newer 35a1feb2 feed uses LA/AZ and records a 32/32 check at its earlier cutoff.
missing_evidence: A current full-feed rebuild after the Chargers–Ravens final, a versioned alias table with provenance for every historical code, and a complete club-by-club reconciliation at the declared cutoff.
cheapest_route: Apply an explicit, versioned code map before joining; leave unknown codes unmatched; rebuild all games and compare every club's GP/W/L/T/PF/PA to same-cut official standings.
answer_status: OPEN — older feed mismatch observed; newer feed requires post-update rebuild
why_it_matters: League totals can balance even while exact team-code joins omit club-level appearances and distort per-team features.
